title: Copper 12-Cup Muffin Pan, Nonstick

comparisons.notes: Same Eternal 12-cup copper nonstick pan: 10.5 x 1.75 x 1.25 in, oven safe to 425F, dishwasher safe; page showed in stock with Add to Cart. Page heading mentions a lid but specs and description list none.

writeup: This Eternal copper-finish 12-cup nonstick muffin pan is just $5.99 new at Woot, while Wayfair sells the same pan for $25.99. It measures 10.5 x 1.75 x 1.25 inches, is oven safe to 425F and goes in the dishwasher. Woot showed only one left.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B07DXCQ54D verified by checker as the same Eternal 12-cup copper muffin pan (UPC 750253938703).
